long_description: Most health companies profit when you buy more tests. Mito profits when you make better decisions. Take a 60-second quiz → get a personalized recommendation: what to test, what to skip, what it costs. Every lab at our published cost (members pay exactly that; non-members +10%). Clinician-reviewed next steps, longitudinal tracking, and an AI Concierge that builds you a panel. $9/mo, cancel anytime. HSA/FSA eligible.
name: Mito Health
one_liner: At-cost lab testing marketplace that profits when you test less
